subject: Human Body
title: Stomach Anatomy
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Stomach Anatomy.

hook.text: Your stomach is a J-shaped pouch that can stretch to hold over a liter of food at once.

buildup.text: Three layers of muscle run in different directions, letting the stomach churn, squeeze, and grind food.

discovery.text: The stomach has four regions: cardia, fundus, body, and pylorus. Each plays a different role in digestion.

twist.text: Most nutrient absorption doesn't happen here. The stomach's main job is to break food into a paste called chyme.

climax.text: The stomach is a muscular mixer and acid bath, preparing food for the small intestine to absorb.

punchline.text: The stomach crushes and dissolves. It doesn't absorb much.

quiz.question: What is the paste-like substance the stomach produces called?
